evidence.reason: The templates configure test instances of existing components. Each rollout compares the committed configuration with the typed request and probes the configured value. The operator configuration schema is unchanged.
The negative input check still calls each linked production factory. The registry supplies the role for the assertion.

A successful update first changes the file destination. After two rejected updates the harness verifies committed configuration, generation, and fresh delivery through that destination and the observer.
The transform query changes the marked record using the same probe as the attribute processor. A fixture is sufficient for all three stages.
The three support cells come from the fixture declaration, including prerequisites. Each cell can earn run evidence only for its own URN and operation.
The report retains an unsuccessful operation when two environments report different outcomes. One component failing leaves other components' delivery results visible.
The header probe uses disposable keys in the fixture's temporary directory. It captures requests on loopback and checks header presence on a phase-specific marked request.
The validation crate owns test configurations and probes. The existing factory registries provide discovery and roles. The report checks the candidate's results against the same catalog.

Each fixture owns its engine, capture files and observer. Fresh stage markers and rollout completion synchronize observations. A failed operation stops only dependent stages, and missing results cannot receive credit.
